text: performance benefits and internal serialization mechanism of using Pydantic return type annotation in FastAPI

text: How should I structure my user data objects if I need to handle sensitive credentials securely?

text: How does a TLS termination proxy handle the lifecycle of digital security credentials when hosting multiple websites on a single server IP?

text: risks of using response_model_include and response_model_exclude versus defining specific sub-models for response_model

text: difference between Security and Depends for FastAPI authentication and endpoint metadata

text: FastAPI --proxy-headers configuration TLS termination proxy HTTPS certificate SNI requirement
